votes.evidence_summary: Collection creation with invalid shardsNum values (0 and -1, both violating the 'shardsNum >= 1' constraint) returned HTTP 200 with code=0 instead of rejecting the invalid parameters
votes.rationale: Constraint milvus_range_collections_create_002 explicitly states shardsNum must be >= 1; the system accepted shardsNum=0 and shardsNum=-1 with HTTP 200 responses, which is a Type1 contract violation (illegal operation accepted)
